meta.title: Tasan — public aggregate cancer-pathway dataset
meta.disclaimer: Public aggregate data only, compiled 2026-11-14. Lung diagnosis-to-treatment times are published only for collaborative areas (YTA), not counties — county cells are shown as “No public data”, never interpolated. Sotkanet 6411, 2676 and 6410 (all-cause primary-care waits, not cancer; Avohilmo gaps in Vantaa, Kerava and Helsinki) are excluded and not shown. The map and county treatment panel use age-adjusted curative-treatment shares (Kuva 16 chart estimates, ±1 pp). The crude Taulukko 11 shares are not shown there. The THL 6-week target starts at referral; published lung intervals start at diagnosis.
meta.national_aggregation: National colorectal screening and referral figures are the Sotkanet “Whole country” (code 358) rows. National lung curative share 27.0% is the published Taulukko 11 / key_findings figure (matches the 22-county numerator sum).

indicator_catalog.label: Colorectal screening participation (invited who attended)
indicator_catalog.target_note: Official Goal 2 follow-up metric: 80% participation in every wellbeing services county and Helsinki (S p. 5; R p. 48). Not a Goal 3 indicator — shown as pathway context.

indicator_catalog.label: Specialist-care referrals processed within 3 days (all specialties)
indicator_catalog.target_note: No official cancer-specific target. This is an all-specialty referral indicator, not a Goal 3 lung-cancer measure.

indicator_catalog.label: Lung cancer: median days from diagnosis to first surgery
indicator_catalog.target_note: THL Ohjaus 21/2016: 6 weeks (42 days) from referral arrival to first treatment. The published medians start at diagnosis, so they understate time from referral. County-level values are not published.

indicator_catalog.label: Lung cancer: age-adjusted share with curative treatment within 12 months (chart estimate, not survival)
indicator_catalog.target_note: Chart estimate from Kuva 16 (±1 pp), age-adjusted, not stage-adjusted, not survival. Men's figure is used for the map colour. The crude Taulukko 11 share is shown only as a secondary line on the hero card.
